description: Repositories and task types for the SE-MCP comparative evaluation (normal AI chat vs MCP-grounded AI).

repos.note: Self-created sample with seeded defects (ground truth known by construction).

taskTypes.label: Architecture explanation
taskTypes.prompt: Analyze this repository and explain its architecture: main folders, important files and how they relate.

taskTypes.label: Dependency risk
taskTypes.prompt: List the project's dependencies, say which are outdated or have known vulnerabilities, and what should be upgraded first.

taskTypes.label: Test generation
taskTypes.prompt: Generate unit test cases (normal, boundary and failure) for the file {{testFile}}.

taskTypes.label: Issue summarisation
taskTypes.prompt: Summarize GitHub issue {{issue}} and say which files or functions of this repository are probably involved.
